screen: ⏺ There is no Capture page. The Snap Basket settings are on the Projects page, in the SNAP BASKET section:
1. Click Projects in the Settings sidebar.
2. Scroll down inside the box on the right. It has its own scroll area. Go past the project list, NOTIFY ME WHEN,
DISPLAY, REFRESH and QUICK CAPTURE.
3. SNAP BASKET has:
- the Screen Recording state, with Turn on…
- the on/off switch for the global shortcuts
- the two shortcuts: ⌃⌥⌘S takes a snap, ⌃⌥⌘B shows the basket
- Speak notes, Send basket with, Keep history
- the list of sent baskets
The snap prompt is on a different page: Runtime › Agent commands › Snap basket prompt.
A snap needs the Screen Recording permission. Turn it on in that section, then quit and open OverSire again.
The section is hard to find, and the Shortcuts page does not list the two snap shortcuts. Do you want me to add them to
the Shortcuts page, with a "Set in Projects › Snap basket" note like the one for New item? A push to main would make a
new release.
